name: list-toolbar
description: Slim result bar for filtered lists: count, page position, sort note, and slots for a view switch and sort control.
designIntent: Every directory rebuilds the same row above its results: "42 events · Page 2 of 5" on the left, a grid/list SegmentedControl and a sort Select on the right. ListToolbar fixes that layout so the summary stays consistent and screen readers hear count changes.

props.name: position
props.description: Page or range position, e.g. "Page 2 of 5" or "Showing 21–40 of 137".

props.name: note
props.description: Muted note after the position, e.g. "Sorted by date, soonest first".

props.name: children
props.description: Controls rendered at the far end: SegmentedControl view switch, sort Select.

examples.title: Directory result bar
examples.code:
<ListToolbar
  count={events.length}
  countLabel="events"
  position={"Page " + page + " of " + pages}
  note="Sorted by date, soonest first"
>
  <SegmentedControl
    options={[{ value: 'grid', label: 'Grid' }, { value: 'list', label: 'List' }]}
    value={view}
    onValueChange={setView}
  />
  <Select label="Sort" options={sortOptions} value={sort} onValueChange={setSort} />
</ListToolbar>
examples.description: Count and position on the left; view switch and sort on the right.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put filter inputs in the bar
antiPatterns.explanation: ListToolbar summarizes results; search fields and filter selects belong in FilterBar above it. Children is for the view switch and sort control only.

accessibility.implementation: The summary line is aria-live=polite so filtering announces the new count
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep count updates meaningful; avoid announcing on every keystroke if the list filters live

guidelines: Use singular nouns for count=1 if the host needs it

compositionRules.relationship: Link-mode SegmentedControl is the canonical grid/list view switch
FilterBar owns the input row above; ListToolbar owns the result summary below it
